channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: Token custody during a routed DEX swap
item.description: Who holds your crypto during a DEX swap? Your tokens stay in your wallet before and after; smart contracts move them through the route in one transaction.

item.title: How does a Solana rug pull drain a liquidity pool?
item.description: How do rug pulls work on Solana? A creator keeps control of liquidity or token permissions, draws in buyers, then drains SOL, mints supply or blocks sellers.

item.title: Polygon Publishes Heimdall v0.14.0 After Purley Goes Live
item.description: Polygon has made Heimdall v0.14.0 public after Purley activated on mainnet and Amoy, adding new checks for validator votes, bridge events, staking updates and checkpoints.

item.title: Which bridge model fits: multisig, validator set or light client?
item.description: Multisig vs light client vs validator bridges: light clients suit large transfers; validator sets or multisigs trade stronger trust for speed and coverage.

item.title: Hong Kong bill would bring four crypto services under SFC rules
item.description: Hong Kong has gazetted a bill to bring crypto dealing, advice, management and custody under SFC oversight, with lawmakers set to consider it on Dec. 2.

item.title: MetaMask Mobile vs Trust Wallet: choose the right DEX wallet
item.description: MetaMask Mobile vs Trust Wallet for DEX trading: choose MetaMask for EVM trades and desktop pairing, or Trust Wallet for holding assets across many chains.

item.title: MetaMask users: replace a shared RPC with your own key
item.description: How do I add my own RPC URL with an API key to MetaMask? Add your provider’s chain-specific HTTPS endpoint, make it the default and check provider activity.

item.title: How Do Wormhole Guardians Verify a Monad Bridge Transfer?
item.description: How do Wormhole Guardians verify my bridge transfer? They wait for Ethereum finality, collect 13 of 19 signatures, then Monad checks the VAA before release.

item.title: A Revoke.cash Revoke Resets the Current Permission
item.description: What does a revoke on revokecash actually change? It zeros an ERC-20 allowance or turns an NFT operator approval off; balances and past transactions remain.

item.title: US court authorizes seizure of $1.2B in Binance crypto
item.description: US says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion tied to the Binance theft, as efforts to recover the crypto continue.

item.title: Wallet signature requests: What can a dApp do?
item.description: What does a wallet signature request allow a dApp to do? A login proves ownership; a permit can set token allowance, so read spender, value and deadline.

item.title: Liquidity pools show how token swaps set prices
item.description: A crypto liquidity pool holds two tokens; traders swap against its reserves, a formula sets prices, and providers earn fees while taking price risk.

item.title: DeFi Lending Liquidation: Debt Repayment and Collateral
item.description: How does liquidation work in DeFi lending? A liquidator repays eligible debt and takes collateral with a bonus, restoring coverage while exposure may remain.

item.title: Ethereum confirmations and Sui checkpoints: What each tells you
item.description: The difference between Ethereum confirmations and Sui checkpoints is block depth versus certified transaction history: one counts later blocks; the other marks batch inclusion.

item.title: Matcha swap slippage and the minimum-output floor
item.description: What does slippage mean on Matcha swap? It is the gap between a quote and execution; tolerance sets the minimum output you accept before the swap fails.

item.title: Small Token Balances to ETH: A One-Chain Sweep
item.description: How to convert small token balances into ETH: swap only tokens worth more than approval and gas, and choose native ETH to avoid an extra unwrap.

item.title: Difference between custodial and non-custodial: who holds keys
item.description: Custodial vs non-custodial exchange: what changes? You hold the keys, approve swaps, pay network gas and protect your wallet when trades settle on-chain.

item.title: DEX Swap Route Hops: How Pools Pass Tokens
item.description: What does each hop in a DEX swap route mean? Each hop is one liquidity-pool swap, passing its output token to the next pool until the route reaches your chosen token.

item.title: US gets court approval to seize $1.2B in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department has court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds, while efforts to trace and recover the rest continue.

item.title: MEV protection vs slippage tolerance: How attacks use your limit
item.description: MEV protection vs slippage tolerance: neither works alone. Slippage caps sandwich losses; private routing hides your swap, while pair depth guides the trade-off.
